title: Four reversibility claims, re-measured: an independent audit of a reversible-computing suite
description: An independent, plan-first audit of the four reversible-computing laboratories in the kostyk348/timelock-ca repository. Two claims survive a predeclared sweep over seeds, sizes, step counts, batch sizes and depths: bit-exact time reversal of a Margolus block automaton, and activation memory that is flat in depth. One weakens: the reported XOR accuracy is below the mean of the same configuration over ten seeds. One fails: the lattice-gas attraction reported from a single seed does not survive 80 runs, where the net force changes sign about half the time. The deposit contains the experiment plan, the measurement harness (Rust, standard library only), every raw log, the number ledger that maps each value in the text to the log it came from, and the LaTeX source of the paper.
notes: Every number in the paper is generated by the accompanying harness from raw logs; every reference was resolved by a machine query before it was cited. See verify_all.sh.
